citations.summary: GitHub OAuth start generates a crypto-random state value and sets it in the github_oauth_state HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie before redirecting to GitHub authorize.
GitHub OAuth callback requires the github_oauth_state cookie, rejects missing or mismatched state values with 400, and clears the state cookie after validation.
After a successful token exchange, the callback persists the GitHub credential via UpsertGitCredential and redirects to /janus?git=success.
Start-route test asserts the authorize redirect includes state and that the github_oauth_state cookie matches it.
Callback tests reject missing state cookies, mismatched state values, and missing state params.
Round-trip callback test mocks a successful exchange, verifies credential persistence with GetGitCredential, and confirms /api/v1/git/providers reports connected=true.
